description:
🚀 Join the EMBA Affiliate Program

EMBA is a premium hydration + creatine brand built for performance, focus, and everyday training. Our products are designed to fuel active lifestyles — from long runs and gym sessions to busy workdays — with clean ingredients, great taste, and real functionality.

We’re looking for creators, athletes, and wellness voices who genuinely believe in what they use and want to earn by sharing it.

💧 Why promote EMBA?

  • Hydration plus creatine — not just another electrolyte brand

  • Designed for daily use, not just elite athletes

  • Clean, transparent formulas

  • Strong crossover between performance & lifestyle

  • A fast-growing brand with strong repeat purchase potential

💸 How you earn

  • 15% commission on every sale

  • 30-day tracking window

  • No earnings cap

  • Monthly payouts

  • Custom affiliate links and discount codes

Top performers may also unlock:

  • Higher commission tiers

  • Long-term partnerships

  • Paid collaborations

📲 How to promote

Promote EMBA in a way that fits your style:

  • Instagram posts, Reels & Stories

  • TikTok videos

  • Training, running, gym or lifestyle content

  • Honest reviews and daily-use integration

We encourage authentic, unscripted content — no scripts, no pressure.

🤝 Extra perks

  • Product gifting for approved affiliates

  • Opportunity to have content whitelisted for paid ads (with permission)

  • Full credit always given to creators

  • Support from our team on campaigns and ideas

If you love the product and your audience trusts you, we’d love to have you on board.

👉 Apply now and fuel your fire with EMBA.
payout_period:
💸 Affiliate Payouts

Affiliate commissions are paid weekly.

All approved commissions earned during the week will be processed and paid out once per week, provided the minimum payout threshold is met. Payments are made via bank transfer or paypal.
